service.name: The Omega Protocol (Ultimate)
service.longDescription: What if Omega's relentless testing had continued, and provided the elusive answer it sought? The minstrel's words invite you to imagine this scenario─to entertain the possibility of that which may have been─and follow the experiment to its ultimate conclusion.

rewards.title: Omega Totem
rewards.text: Ultimate-specific totems that can be exchanged for a weapon of your choosing.

rewards.title: The Alpha Legend
rewards.text: Exclusive title acquired from completing the duty.

rewards.title: Ultimate Achievement
rewards.text: Achievement unlocked upon defeating Alpha Omega in The Omega Protocol.
